rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Conformation order for ethane: staggered (dihedral 60°, minimum energy) > skew > eclipsed (maximum, 12.5 kJ/mol barrier) — draw Newman projections along the C–C axis.  ·  Trick 2: Butane anti conformer is most stable (methyl groups farthest); gauche next — quote 'anti > gauche > eclipsed'.
